title: Skip stories the digest already carries, in different words
intent: Three of the five feed items are stories already in the digest, rewritten by a different outlet — no shared headline, no shared URL, only shared substance. Grades whether the agent actually reads what is in memory before adding to it. A digest that re-lists the same event every day is the failure mode this task exists to catch, and it is invisible unless someone reads the file.

source_facts: Already in the digest under July 23: the Delhi High Court / ANI ruling, and the AI-crawler disclosure bill. Already in under July 22: the APEC Chengdu open-source statement.
Feed items 1, 3 and 5 are those same three stories from different outlets with different wording, so all three are duplicates.

Feed item 2 is new: Moonshot AI in talks at up to $50B ahead of a Hong Kong listing within six months, up from just over $30B in June, with a final pre-IPO round to be discussed in August, following attention from the July 16 Kimi K3 release.

Feed item 4 is new: South Korean Q1 US foreign direct investment up more than 100% year on year to $10.2B, concentrated in chip and battery manufacturing tied to AI infrastructure, extending SK Hynix, Samsung and LG commitments.
The correct outcome is two stories added and three skipped.
traps: Deduping against the search_memory snippet alone. It is capped at 500 characters, which covers the July 23 section and stops before July 22 — so the APEC duplicate is invisible unless the agent reads the whole item. That is why read_memory_item is required here.
Matching on headline or URL, which finds no duplicates at all — every outlet here is different from the one already cited.
Item 3 is the hardest: the existing entry names the bill and its sponsors, this version names neither, and only the substance ties them together.
Over-correcting and dropping item 4 as 'more AI investment news' when the digest carries nothing about South Korean FDI.
Adding all five and reporting five added.
judge.guidance: dedup_accuracy is dominant and is judged on the set written, not on what the agent says it did. reporting_clarity rewards naming which three were skipped and why, so the operator can disagree. Faithfulness on the two new items: the numbers ($50B, $30B, $10.2B, 100%) and the August timing must survive intact.
